selectedFacts.label: timeline and phases
selectedFacts.displayText: Project Aetherium runs from October 1, 2023 to September 30, 2026, with phases for Blue Sky Research, Prototype Development, and Commercialization Path.
selectedFacts.relevance: Supports the kickoff brief timeline, duration, phase structure, and tracking code.

selectedFacts.label: budget
selectedFacts.displayText: The approved budget is 7.2M USD, allocated as 1.8M for Year 1, 2.4M for Year 2, and 3.0M for Year 3.
selectedFacts.relevance: Supports the budget summary and the kickoff next step to confirm spend owners.

selectedFacts.label: owners
selectedFacts.displayText: Dr. Aris Thorne is Principal Investigator, Lena Petrova is Project Manager, and the Year 1 core team includes 4 research engineers and 2 data scientists.
selectedFacts.relevance: Supports the owner line and governance handoff.

selectedFacts.label: governance
selectedFacts.displayText: Quarterly steering committee reviews are scheduled for the second Tuesday of January, April, July, and October.
selectedFacts.relevance: Supports the governance row in the kickoff table.

selectedFacts.label: docs
selectedFacts.displayText: Official docs are maintained in Confluence under Aetherium Project (AET), with the Tech Feasibility & Market Trend Tracker at page ID 8675309.
selectedFacts.relevance: Supports the docs location and tracker next step.

selectedFacts.label: IP
selectedFacts.displayText: Vance & Sterling LLP handles IP matters; the first provisional patent application is scheduled by March 31, 2024, and the main matter uses reference ID ID-IP-2023-004.
selectedFacts.relevance: Supports the IP row and patent follow-up.

selectedFacts.label: infrastructure
selectedFacts.displayText: Phase 1 uses the Prometheus GPU cluster, aetherium-data object storage, and the aetherium_exp_db metadata database.
selectedFacts.relevance: Supports the infrastructure row without opening systems or credentials.
